rss.title: RSS feed
rss.description: Subscribe with an RSS reader and new posts will show up in your reading list.
steps: Get an RSS reader such as Feedly, Inoreader, NetNewsWire, or FreshRSS.
Choose “Add subscription” and paste the URL above.
New posts will sync automatically — no need to visit the site.
rss.note: The feed contains Chinese posts only; the interface language does not affect it.
